question: Which great Indian classical dancer choreographed the songs for Madhuri Dixit in 'Devdas' and 'Dil To Pagal Hai' movies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Birju Maharaj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Birju Maharaj** is one of the most celebrated Indian classical dancers, known for his expertise in Kathak dance.
 
• He choreographed the song "Kahe Chhed Mohe" for Madhuri Dixit in the film **'Devdas'** (2002).
 
• He also choreographed the Kathak sequences for the song "Kaahe Chhed" in the film **'Dil To Pagal Hai'** (1997), performed by Madhuri Dixit.
 
• Birju Maharaj has received numerous awards, including the **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak Dance:**

 
 
• Kathak is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance.
 
• It is traditionally attributed to the traveling bards of ancient northern India known as Kathakars or storytellers.
 
• The dance form emphasizes intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures.
 
 
 
• **Devdas (2002):**
 
 
• Directed by Sanjay Leela Bhansali, the film is based on the 1917 novel of the same name by Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay.
 
• Madhuri Dixit played the role of Chandramukhi, a courtesan.
 
• The film is known for its elaborate set designs and classical dance performances.
 
 
 
• **Dil To Pagal Hai (1997):**
 
 
• Directed by Yash Chopra, the film is a musical romantic drama.
 
• Madhuri Dixit played the role of Pooja, a dancer and choreographer.
 
• The film was notable for its contemporary dance sequences.
 
 
 
• **Padma Vibhushan:**
 
 
• It is the second-highest civilian award in India after the Bharat Ratna.
 
• It is awarded for exceptional and distinguished service in any field including government service.
 
• Birju Maharaj received this honor in 1986 for his contributions to Indian classical dance.
